scripts.infra:dev:up: gh workflow run environment.yml --ref main -f action=up && echo 'Started. Follow it with: gh run watch'
scripts.infra:dev:down: gh workflow run environment.yml --ref main -f action=down && echo 'Started. Follow it with: gh run watch'
scripts.infra:dev:up:local: terraform -chdir=infra/envs/dev-base init -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra/envs/dev-base apply && terraform -chdir=infra/envs/dev init -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra/envs/dev apply
